note: 权限元数据库 —— 单一数据源。看板面板、后端生成 md 附录都从这里读。

scenarios.name: 卡牌收藏 / 拍照识别
scenarios.desc: 相机拍照扫描卡面、相册导入已有卡图、推送提醒
scenarios.desc_en: Camera scanning, photo import, push reminders

scenarios.name: 社区 / UGC
scenarios.desc: 发帖带图、录制语音视频、位置标签
scenarios.desc_en: Photo posting, audio and video recording, location tags

scenarios.name: 健身 / 健康记录
scenarios.desc: 读取健康数据、后台定位记录运动
scenarios.desc_en: Health data, background location, motion tracking

scenarios.name: 纯离线工具
scenarios.desc: 不采集任何敏感权限，仅需网络
scenarios.desc_en: No sensitive permissions, network access only

scenarios.name: 含订阅支付
scenarios.desc: 仅网络 + 推送，无敏感权限
scenarios.desc_en: Network and push only, no sensitive permissions

permissions.name: 相机

ios.desc: 用于拍摄卡牌图片并识别卡面信息
ios.desc_en: Used to photograph trading cards so the app can identify them.

android.desc: 用于拍摄卡牌图片并识别卡面信息
android.desc_en: Used to photograph trading cards so the app can identify them.

permissions.policy_text: 相机权限用于拍摄卡牌图片以识别卡面信息。照片仅用于识别与展示，不会在未经您同意的情况下用于其他目的。
review_notes: iOS 必须在 Info.plist 提供 NSCameraUsageDescription，否则调用相机直接崩溃
Android CAMERA 是危险权限，必须运行时申请；注意 Google Play 对相机权限的用途说明审核
permissions.policy_text_en: Camera access is used to photograph cards so the app can identify them. Photos are used only for identification and display, and are never used for any other purpose without your consent.
review_notes_en: iOS: NSCameraUsageDescription is mandatory. Calling the camera without it crashes the app.
Android: CAMERA is a dangerous permission and must be requested at runtime.
Google Play reviews camera permission usage carefully — the camera must serve a core feature.
Request the permission only when the user taps the scan action, never at launch.
permissions.panel_hint: 勾选即生成 NSCameraUsageDescription 与 android.permission.CAMERA 声明

permissions.name: 相册 / 照片库

infoplist_keys.desc: 用于从相册选择卡牌图片导入收藏
infoplist_keys.desc_en: Used to import card photos you select from your photo library.

infoplist_keys.desc: 用于将识别后的卡牌图片保存到相册
infoplist_keys.desc_en: Used to save identified card photos back to your photo library.

android.manifest_note: Android 13+ 用 READ_MEDIA_IMAGES；12 及以下用 READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
android.desc: 用于从相册选择卡牌图片导入收藏
android.desc_en: Used to import card photos you select from your photo library.

permissions.policy_text: 相册权限用于导入您主动选择的卡牌图片。App 不会扫描或读取您相册中的其他内容。
review_notes: iOS 使用 PhotoKit 新增图片时必须声明 NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription
Android 13+ 必须用 READ_MEDIA_IMAGES，旧权限会被 Google Play 拒绝
permissions.policy_text_en: Photo library access is used to import the card photos you choose. The app does not scan or read any other content in your library, and photos are never uploaded without your action.
review_notes_en: iOS: declare NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription as well if the app writes images via PhotoKit.
Android 13+: use READ_MEDIA_IMAGES. READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE is no longer accepted for new apps.
Android 12 and below: READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE with maxSdkVersion="32".
Google Play: READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USER_SELECTED must be handled if you support photo picker partial access.
permissions.panel_hint: 勾选即生成 NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription、NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription 与 android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES 声明

permissions.name: 麦克风 / 录音

ios.desc_en: Used to record voice notes you attach to a card.

android.desc_en: Used to record voice notes you attach to a card.

permissions.policy_text: 麦克风权限仅在您主动录制语音备注时使用，录音文件保存在您的设备上。
review_notes: iOS 需 NSMicrophoneUsageDescription；Android 需 RECORD_AUDIO 且运行时申请
录音功能在 App Store Connect 需选择「Audio Data」数据类型
permissions.policy_text_en: Microphone access is used only while you are recording a voice note. Recordings are stored on your device and are deleted when you remove them.
review_notes_en: iOS: NSMicrophoneUsageDescription is required.
Android: RECORD_AUDIO is a dangerous permission and must be requested at runtime.
App Store Connect: select “Audio Data” if recordings are transmitted off device.
Do not start recording before the user has granted permission.
permissions.panel_hint: 勾选即生成 NSMicrophoneUsageDescription 与 android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO 声明

permissions.name: 位置（使用期间）

ios.desc: 用于在附近卡店列表中按距离排序
ios.desc_en: Used to sort nearby card shops by distance from you.

android.manifest_note: 同时需要 ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION 才能取得精确位置
android.desc: 用于在附近卡店列表中按距离排序
android.desc_en: Used to sort nearby card shops by distance from you.

permissions.policy_text: 位置权限用于在卡店列表中按距离排序。App 不会在后台收集位置信息。
review_notes: iOS 需区分 WhenInUse 与 Always；只做前台就别申请 Always，否则审核会追问理由
Google Play 对位置权限审核严格，必须说明具体用途并演示核心功能
permissions.policy_text_en: Location access is used to sort the nearby shops list by distance. Your precise location is used only for that sorting and is not retained after the session. The app does not collect location while running in the background.
review_notes_en: iOS: declare NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription. Do not request Always unless background use is essential.
Android: request ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION first; ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION only if precision is needed.
Google Play: location permission requires a clear core-feature justification and a demo.
Request at the moment the user enables distance sorting, not at launch.
permissions.panel_hint: 勾选即生成 NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription 与 android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION 声明

permissions.name: 位置（后台）

infoplist_keys.desc: 用于在后台记录运动轨迹
infoplist_keys.desc_en: Used to keep recording your workout route in the background.

infoplist_keys.desc: 用于在记录运动轨迹时获取位置
infoplist_keys.desc_en: Used to keep recording your workout route in the background.

android.desc: 用于在后台记录运动轨迹
android.desc_en: Used to keep recording your workout route in the background.

permissions.policy_text: 后台位置权限用于在您开启运动记录时持续记录轨迹，关闭记录后立即停止采集。
review_notes: 后台位置权限审核极严：Google Play 要求单独申请权限页面并演示核心功能
iOS 必须同时提供 AlwaysAndWhenInUse 与 WhenInUse 两个 key
建议：无明确必要不要申请，误申请是常见拒审原因
permissions.policy_text_en: Background location access is used to continue recording your route while a workout is in progress. Collection stops as soon as you end the workout, and background location is never used outside an active session.
review_notes_en: iOS: declare both NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescription and NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription.
Google Play: background location requires a dedicated permission screen and an in-app justification flow.
Google Play: ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION must be requested separately from foreground location.
Only request this if background route recording is a core feature. It is a common rejection cause.
permissions.panel_hint: 勾选即生成 NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescription、NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription 与 android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION 声明

permissions.name: 推送通知

ios.note: iOS 推送不需要 Info.plist 声明，但必须在用户主动同意后请求授权

android.desc: 用于提醒卡包更新与活动通知
android.desc_en: Used to notify you about collection updates and upcoming events.

permissions.policy_text: 推送通知用于提醒卡包更新与活动信息。您可以随时在系统设置中关闭通知。
review_notes: iOS 必须在用户主动操作后请求通知授权，不可启动即弹
Android 13+ 必须运行时申请 POST_NOTIFICATIONS；Google Play 要求声明通知权限用途
permissions.policy_text_en: Notifications are used to tell you about collection updates and events. You can turn them off at any time in your system settings, and the app works normally without them.
review_notes_en: iOS: no Info.plist key is required, but you must request authorization after a user action.
iOS: never show a notification permission prompt at launch — Apple reviews this.
Android 13+: POST_NOTIFICATIONS must be requested at runtime.
Google Play: declare the notification permission purpose in the Data safety form.
permissions.panel_hint: 勾选即生成 android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS 声明

permissions.name: 健康数据

infoplist_keys.desc: 用于读取运动数据以计算卡牌收集进度
infoplist_keys.desc_en: Used to read your workout records and calculate your collection progress.

infoplist_keys.desc: 用于记录运动完成状态
infoplist_keys.desc_en: Used to read your workout records and calculate your collection progress.

android.desc: 用于读取运动数据以计算卡牌收集进度
android.desc_en: Used to read your workout records and calculate your collection progress.

permissions.policy_text: 健康数据权限用于读取运动记录并计算卡牌收集进度。数据不会离开您的设备。
review_notes: iOS HealthKit 需要额外配置 HealthKit capability 与 entitlement
Health 数据属于敏感信息，App Store 审核会重点检查
permissions.policy_text_en: Health data access is used to read workout records and calculate how much of your collection you have completed. Health data stays on your device and is never transmitted to us.
review_notes_en: iOS: enable the HealthKit capability and add the HealthKit entitlement.
iOS: HealthKit data requires explicit per-type authorization from the user.
App Store Connect: Health & Fitness is a sensitive data type and is reviewed strictly.
Never make Health access a prerequisite for using the core app.
permissions.panel_hint: 勾选即生成 NSHealthShareUsageDescription、NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription 与 android.permission.health.READ_EXERCISE 声明

permissions.name: 运动传感器

ios.desc: 用于识别摇晃卡包动作
ios.desc_en: Used to detect a shake gesture on your collection.

android.desc: 用于识别摇晃卡包动作
android.desc_en: Used to detect a shake gesture on your collection.

permissions.policy_text: 运动传感器权限用于识别摇晃动作，不采集任何生理数据。
review_notes: iOS 的 CMMotionActivityManager 实际不需要用户授权，但调用前应声明以防审核质疑
permissions.policy_text_en: Motion sensor access is used to recognize a shake gesture. No biometric or physiological data is collected.
review_notes_en: iOS: CMMotionActivityManager does not actually require user authorization, but declaring the usage description avoids review questions.
Android: BODY_SENSORS is a dangerous permission and must be requested at runtime.
Request only when the user enables the shake gesture, not at launch.
permissions.panel_hint: 勾选即生成 NSMotionUsageDescription 与 android.permission.BODY_SENSORS 声明

permissions.name: 通讯录

ios.desc: 用于邀请好友一起收集卡牌
ios.desc_en: Used to let you invite friends to collect cards with you.

android.desc: 用于邀请好友一起收集卡牌
android.desc_en: Used to let you invite friends to collect cards with you.

permissions.policy_text: 通讯录权限仅在您主动邀请好友时读取联系方式。
review_notes: 通讯录属于高敏感权限，App Store 审核会要求清晰说明，且不能强制授权才能使用核心功能
permissions.policy_text_en: Contacts access is used only when you choose to invite a friend. We do not upload your address book, and no contact data is collected or shared otherwise.
review_notes_en: iOS: NSContactsUsageDescription is required.
Android: READ_CONTACTS is a dangerous permission and must be requested at runtime.
App Store Connect: Contacts is a sensitive data type and is reviewed strictly.
Never gate the core app behind contacts access, and always offer a non-contacts alternative.
permissions.panel_hint: 勾选即生成 NSContactsUsageDescription 与 android.permission.READ_CONTACTS 声明

permissions.name: 跨应用追踪 (ATT)

ios.desc: 用于衡量广告效果并优化投放
ios.desc_en: Used to measure the effectiveness of advertising and improve our campaigns.

android.desc: 用于广告归因与效果衡量
android.desc_en: Used to measure the effectiveness of advertising and improve our campaigns.

permissions.policy_text: 跨应用追踪权限用于衡量广告投放效果。您可以在系统设置中随时关闭，且关闭后不影响 App 核心功能。
review_notes: iOS 必须提供 NSUserTrackingUsageDescription，否则调用 ATT API 直接崩溃
ATT 弹窗必须在用户主动操作后触发，且弹窗前不得调用任何追踪 API
未获得授权时不得初始化任何追踪 SDK，且 IDFA 不可用
permissions.policy_text_en: Cross-app tracking permission is used to measure advertising performance so we can improve our campaigns. You can turn it off at any time in your system settings, and the app remains fully functional without it.
review_notes_en: iOS: NSUserTrackingUsageDescription is mandatory. Calling the ATT API without it crashes the app.
iOS: show the ATT prompt only after a user action, and do not call any tracking API before the prompt.
iOS: if the user denies or restricts tracking, do not initialize any tracking SDK and do not read IDFA.
Android: com.google.android.gms.permission.AD_ID is required for advertising ID access on Android 13+.
App Store Connect: if you track, declare Tracking, Identifiers and Advertising Data.
permissions.panel_hint: 勾选即生成 NSUserTrackingUsageDescription 与 AD_ID 声明

permissions.name: 网络访问

ios.note: iOS 无需声明；Android 需要 INTERNET 权限（安装时自动授予）

android.desc: 用于访问服务器同步卡包数据
android.desc_en: Used to sync your collection data with our servers.

review_notes: Android 的 INTERNET 属于普通权限，安装时自动授予，无需运行时申请
review_notes_en: iOS: no permission declaration is required.
Android: INTERNET is a normal permission granted automatically at install time.
permissions.panel_hint: 勾选即生成 android.permission.INTERNET 声明

permissions.name: 文件存储

ios.note: iOS 沙盒机制无需声明；如用文档共享需加 UIFileSharingEnabled

android.manifest_note: 仅当 targetSdk <= 32 需要；33+ 用 READ_MEDIA_IMAGES 或完全不需要
android.desc: 用于导入本地卡牌图片
android.desc_en: Used to import card images stored on your device.

review_notes: Google Play 已收紧外部存储权限，新项目建议完全不用
review_notes_en: iOS: the app sandbox requires no permission. Add UIFileSharingEnabled only if you offer file sharing.
Android: READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE is only needed for targetSdk 32 or lower; use READ_MEDIA_IMAGES or no permission at all on newer targets.
permissions.panel_hint: 勾选即生成 android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE 声明

permissions.name: 蓝牙

ios.desc: 用于连接蓝牙设备同步卡包
ios.desc_en: Used to connect to your Bluetooth devices to sync your collection.

android.desc: 用于连接蓝牙设备同步卡包
android.desc_en: Used to connect to your Bluetooth devices to sync your collection.

permissions.policy_text: 蓝牙权限用于连接您的硬件设备同步卡包数据。
review_notes: Android 12+ 必须用 BLUETOOTH_CONNECT，旧权限已废弃
permissions.policy_text_en: Bluetooth access is used to connect to your own devices so they can sync collection data. The app does not scan for or connect to devices you have not selected.
review_notes_en: iOS: declare NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription (iOS 13+).
Android 12+: use BLUETOOTH_CONNECT and BLUETOOTH_SCAN; the legacy BLUETOOTH / BLUETOOTH_ADMIN permissions are deprecated.
Android: requesting a Bluetooth permission triggers a nearby-devices permission prompt.
Request when the user starts a sync, not at launch.
permissions.panel_hint: 勾选即生成 NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription 与 android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT 声明

appstore_data_types.note: 仅在用户主动录音后收集
